round: independent-review F1-F5 remediation, review baseline b48dc44d519c1d2813dabd33e5a85a50e7f8da9c
items: F4: plugin and tool identity verified from the binary and the current sources, not from presence

problem.redact_plugin: resolvePlugin accepted tools/bin/protoc-gen-go-redact after a bare os.Stat, so a stale binary kept generating for a package whose sources had changed; the reviewer's probe showed the build script was never invoked
problem.path_plugins: a PATH plugin was only asked for its --version banner and the result was printed, never compared with anything, so a shell script printing "protoc-gen-go v0.0.0" passed preflight
problem.buf: ensureBufInstalled checked that buf answers, and the banner was logged without a version comparison in the tool

rules_now.identity_source: go version -m on the resolved binary; the recorded main package path and the mod version are compared with migration/patches/T15/T15-tool-lock.json, which already carried those coordinates from the same measurement method
rules_now.why_not_the_version_flag: a banner is text the program chooses to print, and some plugins do not support the flag at all; a binary whose build info cannot be read fails the run instead of defaulting to success, and the refusal says so
rules_now.real_executable: the resolved file must be a regular file with an executable bit, so a non-executable or a directory cannot be a tool
rules_now.redact_rebuild: scripts/build-redact-plugin.sh runs for every generation from a direct gow api as well as from make api, so both entries share one preparation; the Go build cache carries the repeat cost
rules_now.once_per_run: verification is memoized per tool and the owned plugin is built once per generation, not once per template; a failed attempt is remembered too so eleven templates cannot trigger eleven rebuilds
rules_now.provenance_of_the_built_binary: the built plugin must report this repository's module and the package path go-wind-admin/pkg/localdeps/go-wind-toolkit/protoc-gen-go-redact, and its dependency list must contain no github.com/tx7do/ module
rules_now.not_touched: each template keeps its own already approved plugin versions (the slices still pin protoc-gen-go-grpc v1.6.0 and protoc-gen-go-http v2.0.0-20251205160234 while the PATH tools stay at v1.6.2 and v2.0.0-20260404020628): nothing was unified, nothing is installed at @latest, the user's GOBIN tools were not rewritten, and no tx7do module came back

cases: TestPinnedToolIdentityAcceptsTheBinaryItClaimsToBe (accept at the recorded coordinates, reject a moved version, reject a moved package, reject an unpinned name, reject a non-executable file, both through PATH and through the direct path a file plugin takes)
TestImpostorWithAWrongVersionBannerIsRejected (the reviewer's v0.0.0 script: refused, and the banner text never reaches the decision)

TestOwnedPluginIsRebuiltFromCurrentSourcesEvenWhenPresent (the build script really runs against a pre-existing binary; a failing build surfaces; four templates naming one plugin cause exactly one build)
TestToolLockCoversEveryNamedPlugin (every PATH plugin named by the eleven active templates has a lock entry, and buf itself is pinned)
TestToolLockRejectsADamagedFile (7 damaged lock shapes plus a missing file)
TestLoadToolLockReadsTheRealFile (the committed lock loads completely, pins nothing to a floating version and names no tx7do module)
unit_regressions.fixture_note: TestPreflightFailsWithoutTouchingOutputs now writes a go.mod and a tool lock into its temporary root, because preflight legitimately requires both; the assertions are unchanged and it still proves nothing is created or touched when preflight fails

end_to_end.redact_build_once: "preflight: building protoc-gen-go-redact from the current pkg/localdeps sources" appears exactly once for eleven templates, followed by its module and sha256
end_to_end.go_run_pins: the pinned `go run module@version` plugins are still resolved against the local module cache only, with no fetch and no install
end_to_end.result: the accepted artifacts are reproduced unchanged: digest 96184d0165d5bfd1, 396 files, 0 to write
